SddAmplifyNfr.keywords: nfr, amplify, budgets, latency, throughput, scale, availability, consistency, bottlenecks, degradation, sdd-amplify-nfr
SddAmplifyNfr.Mission:
Turn performance and reliability signals into ordinary atomic requirements: latency / throughput / scale / availability / consistency as numbers, plus observable overload behaviour. Loaded lazily by the discovery interview's triage when the scope carries load, growth, or availability expectations; inherits the session core — not repeated here.
Input — the scope spec draft + interview context (usage profile signals). Output — flat requirement entries in the canonical Requirements section + follow-up items on the discovery interview map. Out of scope: benchmark methodology and load-test tooling — detailed material belongs in Architecture or one referenced supporting section only when genuinely needed.
SddAmplifyNfr.BeliefState:
Inherited from the loading directive (already in context): QUESTION_FORMAT
An amplification opens with a ready answer, not a questionnaire. FIRST assemble a complete defaults package — the decisions live products of this class actually ship with (run a short targeted research pass when class practice is uncertain, grounded in the scope's intent) — and present it as ONE accept-or-edit reply: the operator takes everything with one word or edits by item number. Ask via the AskUserQuestion / multi-question tool when available; fallback `QUESTION_FORMAT`. Deep-dive questions open only for topics the operator explicitly marks deep-dive; every untouched topic keeps its default. An accepted default is a real decision — record it like one.
Every non-obvious decision → a Decision Log entry in `DECISION_LOG_ENTRY_FORMAT` — one line, the expanded part in parentheses: `-DL-N — (почему: …; отвергнуто: …; риск: …)`; IDs are stable. Non-obvious only (`AX_DECISION_LOG_NON_OBVIOUS`): a pick already recorded in the spec's own tables is never duplicated as a DL row. Which decisions qualify and which Decision Log receives the entry are specified per directive.
A non-functional constraint is a number plus its measurement condition: latency as a percentile under stated load (`p95 ≤ 200ms @ 100 RPS`), availability as a target with an error budget, scale as concrete volumes (rows, RPS, concurrent users, growth horizon), consistency as a named model. «Fast», «reliable», «scales» are placeholders, not constraints — replace each with a measurable budget, or record an explicit «не бюджетируем, потому что …» decision.
Последовательный `await` независимых задач складывает их задержки (Latency). Параллельный запуск сводит общую задержку к самой медленной задаче.
Чтение данных быстрее, чем их может обработать потребитель, накапливает бесконечный буфер в RAM. Игнорирование Backpressure — это прямой путь к OOM на устройствах с 4-8 GB памяти.
SddAmplifyNfr.HaltConditions: | 🛑 ID | Trigger | |---|---| | `H_NO_USAGE_SIGNAL` | Neither the spec draft nor the operator gives any scale / load signal to budget against — return the question to the interview | | `H_OPERATOR_REJECTS_DEFAULTS` | Operator declines the whole defaults package and skips deep-dive — leave the spec untouched |

Step.Goal: Assemble the numeric budget package for this product class.
Step.Action: Extract the usage profile from the spec draft (who calls what, how often, how much data). Per `AX_AMPLIFY_DEFAULTS_FIRST`, draft one observable outcome per relevant dimension — latency, throughput, scale + growth horizon, availability, consistency — with numbers live products of this class actually hold (per `AX_BUDGETS_ARE_NUMBERS`; short targeted research when class practice is uncertain). Name the expected first bottleneck and the degradation posture under overload (shed / queue / reject — mind `AX_BACKPRESSURE_IS_LAW`, `AX_LATENCY_STACKING`). A dimension with no design consequence is not an entry. No usage signal at all → `H_NO_USAGE_SIGNAL`.

Step.Goal: One accept-or-edit gate; deep-dive only on explicit pick.
Step.Action: Present the candidate outcomes as ONE compact reply per `AX_AMPLIFY_DEFAULTS_FIRST` (AskUserQuestion when available, else `QUESTION_FORMAT`); each dimension accept / edit / deep-dive. Deep-dive topic map: load profile → latency budget → scale horizon → availability + error budget → consistency → bottlenecks → degradation. A dimension the operator consciously skips gets an explicit «не бюджетируем, потому что …» row. STOP.

Step.Goal: Write the agreed outcomes as current-format requirements.
Step.Action:
Use the Requirements section's embedded grammar; do not preload a separate format. Continue the spec's next unused sequential `-REQ-` IDs. Write one ordinary flat entry per accepted observable outcome, with modality class, behaviour sentence, and short `Constraint`, `Verification`, and `Trace` lines; quantified budgets stay numeric. Never create `### Non-Functional Constraints`, another topic heading, or a table inside Requirements.
If the existing Requirements section is legacy split/topic format, read it as input and migrate the whole section to flat entries in this already-approved edit; preserve every still-valid outcome and do not leave a mixed representation or ask for a second approval. A benchmark/load-profile table belongs in Architecture by default, or in one explicitly named supporting section outside Requirements only when the detail is genuinely needed; link it from `Trace`. Non-default picks and notable accepted defaults → Decision Log per `AX_DECISION_LOG_REQUIRED`. Budgets still needing reality validation → discovery interview map, not vague requirements. Return control to the interview.

SddAmplifyNfr.ChatOutput: Service line — dim, internal, never narrated (`AX_NO_PROCESS_NARRATION`): `📐 AMP_NFR · dims= · accepted= · edited= · dive=`.
